content: Indication-specific dosing for the combination of Adam's needle, aloe yucca, and bear grass yucca includes the following considerations: There are no standard dosing guidelines. However, traditional use suggests a dosage of 380–490 mg of powdered yucca stalk or root taken two to three times daily (BID-TID). Yucca is an FDA-approved food additive. This combination has been used for various conditions, including osteoarthritis, hypertension, migraine headaches, colitis, hypercholesterolemia, stomach disorders, diabetes, poor circulation, and liver and gallbladder disorders. It has also been applied topically for sores, skin diseases, inflammation, bleeding, sprains, broken limbs, joint pain, baldness, and dandruff. Clinical evidence supporting its effectiveness in treating osteoarthritis is unreliable. However, it may help reduce hypercholesterolemia and hypertension when combined with proper diet and exercise. At routine doses, no adverse effects are typically observed. However, high doses may cause loose stools. While in vitro studies have shown that it can cause hemolysis, this effect has never been demonstrated in humans. Regarding pregnancy and lactation: Pregnancy Category: Not applicable (N/A). Lactation: Not applicable (N/A). In general, it is considered acceptable, as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
